title: Atmospheric oxidation of fenthion initiated by hydroxyl radical and ozone
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1323-1337
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00984G, Paper
A. Bhavadharini, L. Sandhiya, K. Senthilkumar
Fenthion reacts rapidly with atmospheric ˙OH, while its reaction with O3 is slow. The PS is found to be highly reactive. The subsequent reactions with O2, and ˙OH, forms closed-shell products which are developmental toxicants.
